ELECTRICITY — TERMLY EXAM #6
====

GRADE: Grade 11
SUBJECT: ELECTRICITY
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. When learning Electrical Diagrams, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Electrical Diagrams.
   B. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Electrical Diagrams.
   C. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Electrical Diagrams.
   D. Skip safety briefings for Electrical Diagrams.

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. Speaker
   B. Monitor
   C. Keyboard
   D. CPU

3. When learning Orthographic Projection, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

12. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Overload every socket
   B. Ignore burnt cables
   C. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

13. ICT stands for: (1 mark)

   B. Internal Cooking Timer

----
17. In three clear sentences, explain Single Phase AC Generators and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

18. In three clear sentences, explain Wiring Systems and Regulations and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
